name: mobilenetv2
_source: Sandler et al. 2018, MobileNetV2: Inverted Residuals and Linear Bottlenecks, Table 2 (https://arxiv.org/abs/1801.04381). Standard 224x224 ImageNet classification config, width multiplier 1.0.
_notes: avgpool (7x7, before the classifier) is not modeled - pooling has no MACs and would run on a separate unit or the CPU, not the NPU.
classifier is modeled as a single dense GEMM (M=1) over the pooled 1280-d feature vector - see Expander.fc() in model_to_npu_calls.py.
